title_sq: APARTAMENT 2+1 PER SHITJE TEK RRUGA E KOSOVAREVE
description_sq: Ofrohet per shitje nje apartament 2+1 i cili eshte i pozicionuar ne katin e 6 banim te nje ndertimi te ri me ashensor te vitit 2023 me fasade te ventiluar. Organizohet ne nje korridor te vogel, nje soxhorno spacioze,dy dhoma gjumi ku ajo matrimoniale eshte me garderobe dhe tualet te brendshem me ajrim natyral,dy tualete, nje dhome lavanderi dhe dy ballkone. Aparetamenti eshte totalisht i arreduar me arkitekt dhe materiale cilesore dhe ofrohet i mobiluar si ne foto. Objekti ne te cilin ndodhet eshte nder me cilesoret ne zone dhe me nje cilesi te mire ndertimi. Zona ju ofron te gjitha facilitetet e nevojshme ,kopshte ,markete,shkolla, aksesi me liqenin artificial etj. Ne cmim gjithashtu eshte i perfshire dhe nje post parkimi ne -1.
title_en: 2+1 APARTMENT FOR SALE ON KOSOVARI STREET
description_en: A 2+1 apartment is offered for sale, which is located on the 6th residential floor of a new building with an elevator from 2023 with a ventilated facade. It is organized in a small corridor, a spacious living room, two bedrooms where the matrimonial one has a wardrobe and an internal toilet with natural ventilation, two toilets, a laundry room and two balconies. The apartment is completely furnished with architect and quality materials and is offered furnished as in the photo. The building in which it is located is one of the best in the area and with a good quality of construction. The area offers all the necessary facilities, gardens, markets, schools, access to the artificial lake, etc. The price also includes a parking post at -1.
